vectors.claim: Pursuit identity begins at an explicit version.
Creation cannot overwrite an existing Pursuit.
Revision binds the exact predecessor version.
A stale revision fails closed.
Revision cannot silently skip versions.
Fork lineage names the exact source version.
A fork cannot claim an unbound lineage.
A fork has an independently addressable identity.
Settlement requires an explicit completion verdict.
Call success is not Pursuit completion.
A sealed Episode is not Pursuit completion.
Fact admission alone is not Pursuit completion.
Settlement binds the current Pursuit version.
A settled Pursuit cannot be revised in place.
Settlement never infers a verdict.
An Atlas Cut binds explicit source roots.
A Cut cannot be inferred from ambient context.
A derivation binds its exact source Cut.
Derivation cannot silently change its causal Cut.
Derived views remain rooted.
Refresh names both old Cut and source root.
Refresh fails on stale Cut identity.
Source drift is explicit, not overwritten.
Staleness is a typed state transition.
Staleness cannot be a silent flag.
A stale Cut cannot be presented as current context.
Refresh output remains content-addressed.
A minimal Cut can contain one explicit source.
A Cut inventory is set-like and deterministic.
Repeated stale transitions do not invent new history.
A Warrant is explicit, bounded, and rooted.
Authority cannot be ambient.
Attenuation may reduce allowed actions.
Attenuation never adds authority.
Attenuation may shorten time.
Attenuation never extends expiry.
Delegation carries an attenuated authority subset.
Cross-Hub delegation cannot add actions.
Delegation cannot silently widen scope.
Delegation cannot extend time.
Revocation binds the issuing authority root.
An unrelated authority cannot revoke a Warrant.
Use is checked against action, scope, time, and revocation.
A Warrant does not authorize undeclared actions.
Authority remains scoped.
Expired authority fails closed.
Revoked authority cannot be reused.
Revocation terminates the derivation chain.
Delegation declares a usable bounded action set.
Derived authority retains its root lineage.
Consequential action binds direction, perspective, authority, and occurrence.
Action does not infer direction from occurrence.
Action does not infer perspective from ambient context.
Action does not infer authority from capability.
Occurrence remains independently addressable.
A bound action still checks exact preconditions.
A revoked Warrant cannot authorize action.
Delivery is not admission.
A transport receipt cannot manufacture a semantic verdict.
Occurrence is not completion.
A sealed Episode cannot settle a Pursuit by inference.
Call success is not Fact admission.
Execution success cannot self-admit a Fact.
Admission is local to the receiving authority.
A producer cannot self-admit a remote Fact.
Episode identity begins before occurrence.
Open cannot overwrite an Episode.
Append order is explicit.
Episode order cannot skip silently.
Episode claims remain rooted.
Commit establishes a durability frontier.
Commit cannot acknowledge unrooted content.
Interruption is a typed lifecycle state.
Seal closes occurrence without inventing completion.
Seal requires the commit frontier.
Replay checks the sealed semantic root.
Replay exposes semantic drift.
Fact production is distinct from admission.
The receiving authority owns admission.
A producer cannot self-admit a remote Fact.
Rejection is an explicit receiver verdict.
Conflict roots remain visible.
Conflict cannot collapse to last-write-wins.
Supersession preserves predecessor identity.
A proposal cannot silently rewrite its own verdict.
Acknowledgement stays behind the durability frontier.
Crash evidence exposes acknowledgements that outran durability.
Reopen binds the persisted provider root.
Reopen fails closed on provider drift.
Fsck compares expected and observed roots.
Fsck exposes corruption rather than repairing silently.
Export binds a portable rooted bundle.
Export never relies on an ambient directory.
Import verifies the declared bundle root.
Import fails closed on bundle drift.
Replay order is contiguous and deterministic.
Replay cannot hide missing history.
Retry with the same key preserves the exchange root.
An idempotency key cannot name different exchanges.
Reconnect retains conflicting roots instead of last-write-wins.
